name: partial-span-preservation

changeScope.exceptionSwallow: unchanged - PdfBlockAnalyst's per-batch catch still discards that batch's spans, still records failureClass

spanLaneStatusSemantics: unchanged - a partial_timeout run still reports spanLaneStatus: partial_timeout honestly; this manifest changes what spanAnalysis carries, never the status field's meaning

acceptanceGate.7_crossDocumentRegression: INSUFFICIENT_EXISTING_EVIDENCE - only 001 and 003 have ever produced retained span-lane evidence anywhere in this repository; not forced to a pass by absence, no document manufactured to force a verdict
